objective: Bounded project business metric queries, deterministic computation and evidence-driven analysis using reviewed semantic definitions and real observations

v08Relationship.entryAndDomainQA: Delivered within existing V08-R01/R03/R06/R14 and V08-E01/E03/E06/E15 scope; actual values and analytical computations are separate.
v08Relationship.dependentImplementation: Requires actual accepted consumption, authorization, snapshot and version contracts; no date or automatic start.
v08Relationship.reconstructionBoundary: L1/L2/L3 claims do not establish production-data availability or metric correctness.

initialScope: One privately authorized real business domain
Finite reviewed indicator set and independent expected answers
Limited named sources and read-only analysis
Fixed metric definitions, explicit time ranges and bounded grouping/baseline comparisons
metricContract: Semantic data mappings and reviewed source/version provenance

ownership.ontology: Metric meanings and semantic mappings/version compatibility; not live metric storage or collection execution.
ownership.harness: Completeness/quality/threshold evaluation and independent correctness checks; retains existing online observation ownership.
ownership.runtime: New authorized collection/query execution, identities, budgets, receipts, cancellation and uncertain-outcome recovery; retained reads need no new Run by default.
ownership.parent: Question routing/clarification, public-owner API composition and consistent evidence-linked presentation.
ownership.adaptersAndCalculation: Assign explicit owner/result retention and authority in the future execution design; no duplicate owner database.

acceptanceThemes: Real bounded journey, independent numeric oracle and reproducible pinned calculation
Ambiguous/conflicting definitions, missing/stale/partial inputs, zero denominators and incompatible units/time ranges
Both comparison definitions/snapshots pinned; drift and incompatible grain/filter/source semantics visible
Scoped access, revoked credentials, malicious text/query injection and time/cost/row/byte limits
Cancellation, duplicate/lost responses, restart and exact uncertain-outcome reconciliation
Every number and claim resolves to evidence; model cannot invent values or causal conclusions
Actual installed consumers and Expert agree with owner results, completeness and limitations
beforeImplementation: Select real pilot privately and freeze independent requirements/answers
Bind exact repositories/files and accepted dependency contracts
Freeze positive/negative/missing/stale/recovery variants and resource budgets
Resolve adapter/calculation/result ownership and authority through necessary ADRs
Record explicit execution Target; boundary/trust changes require formal Roadmap/ADR/migration/guard review
excluded: All-database connector catalogue or unbounded cross-source federation
New hosted graph or metrics platform
preserve: Existing owner boundaries and Harness online observations
All v0.8 reconstruction and pilot requirements
privacyPolicy: Real project selection, data, credentials and evidence stay private; public examples are synthetic.
progressPolicy: Candidate registration records direction only; no passing acceptance, installed capability, date or release commitment is claimed.
